grading_policy: better material/form/craftsmanship at higher quality; never just brighter or flashier
positive_observations: All five colors share an upright oval stone family. Stage1 missing edges and stage2 diagonal cracks are readable at source80/vendor48.
Stage3/4 are intact; stage4 favors a smoother edge, cleaner face and broader controlled natural highlights rather than glow or decorative fittings.
Black jade retains gray edge/face highlights against dark and black cells. Clean cutouts have no rectangular visible background.
The gourd retains both lobes, stopper and complete indigo cord/loop; brown gourd and blue cord remain distinct in the provisional1x2 bag slot.
